reason: I buy lighting from Wayfair, Lowe's or Amazon because I know how delivery and returns work there, and I walked out of a showroom last weekend without buying anything. The free returns and UL listing help, but I'm not switching to a store I've never heard of for a fixture I can't see in person.
objection: Sixty reviews on a store nobody knows is thin next to the thousands I see at the big retailers, and $249 is a lot to hand over before I know what the paper actually looks like on my ceiling.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the same pendant on Wayfair or Amazon with a few hundred reviews, or the store sending me a cheap physical sample of the shade to hold up in my room first.
